{{Top|leg}}
A '''paatchi ball''' was an object in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. As [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] reached a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] point three [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]] from [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]], they were pulled out of hyperspace by a squadron of [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defenders]] and [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]], and forced into a dogfight in the middle of an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]]. As Solo outmaneuvered the pursuing [[TIE series/Legends|TIE fighters]], an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] roughly the size of a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] made a sharp forty-five-degree turn in a manner similar to as if it had bounced off of a paatchi ball, then tore through the fighter of the TIE squadron's flight leader.<ref name="Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>
